judge.rationale: The candidate ignored the explicit specifications and acceptance criteria in the issue, inventing its own frame and type names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` instead of `list_conversations` / `conversation_list`). It directly contradicted the issue's security and reliability decisions by omitting the opt-in `transport.history` configuration flag (leaving history exposed by default), omitting `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, and returning an empty list `{sessions: []}` when `store.listFor` is unimplemented instead of an error. Furthermore, its validator accepts `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` instead of enforcing the 1–200 integer range specified in the ticket. It also failed to update `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, while leaving a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the tree.
